Worked example: 1,000 dentists with 10 reviews each

Same job on both actors, Free-plan prices:

  • NanoScrape: 1,000 places = $1.00, plus 10,000 reviews = $3.00. Total about $4.00.
  • Compass: 1,000 places = $4.00, plus the place-detail add-on for 1,000 places = $2.00, plus 10,000 reviews = $5.00. Total about $11.00.

For a first test, 100 places cost about $0.10 on NanoScrape and $0.40 on Compass, both well inside Apify's monthly free credit.

Which one to pick

Pick NanoScrape's Google Maps Scraper if

  • you want the full place row at one flat price per place, with no add-ons to switch on;
  • you pull large lists (whole cities, many categories), where the per-place price dominates the bill;
  • you want reviews at $0.30 per 1,000.

Pick Compass if

  • you need its lead, social-profile, email-verification or competitor-analysis add-ons in the same run;
  • you prefer the actor with the most users in the Store (about 47,500 in the last 30 days).
Finding it in the Store: search the Apify Store for google maps scraper santamaria, or open it directly with the button above. You can run it from the Apify Console, the API or an MCP client.

FAQ

Do I need an API key or a Google account?

No. Both actors run on Apify and read public Google Maps listings. You need a free Apify account.

Are the prices the same for everyone?

No. Both actors list a Free-plan price and lower prices on paid Apify plans. The table shows Free-plan prices because that is what a new account pays.

Does the output look the same?

Close, not identical. Both return name, address, phone, website, rating, review count, coordinates and opening hours per place; field names differ (for example review_rating vs totalScore), so check the column names before you swap one for the other in an existing pipeline.

How do I get emails?

Google Maps does not list emails. With NanoScrape, set enableEmailExtraction to true; the website lookup runs through the Website Email & Phone Scraper and is billed per page it crawls. Compass offers a contact-details add-on per place.

Try it on one city first

Run 100 places in your city on the Free plan; it costs about $0.10.
